[APPENDIX] Enforcement Decree of the Salt Industry Cooperatives Act [Table]

Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines (Related to Article 7)

| Violation | Legal basis | Administrative fine |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Using the name "salt industry cooperative" or a similar name in violation of Article 3 of the Act | Article 60 (1) of the Act | 1,000,000 won |
| 2. An officer, employee, or liquidator of a cooperative failing to perform registration required under Articles 49 through 52, Article 85, or Article 94 of the Civil Act, as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 5 of the Act | Article 60 (2) 1 of the Act | 1,000,000 won |
| 3. An officer or employee of a cooperative failing to make a public announcement or demand, or making a false announcement or demand, in violation of Article 44 (2) of the Act | Article 60 (2) 2 of the Act | 1,000,000 won |
